derivation: or מְעִינִי; probably patrial from H4584 (מָעוֹן);
def: a Meunite, or inhabitant of Maon (only in plural)

occurrences.text: And God helped him against the Philistines, and against the Arabians that dwelt in Gur–baal, and the Mehunims.
The children of Asnah, the children of Mehunim, the children of Nephusim,
The children of Besai, the children of Meunim, the children of Nephishesim,
